correctness.rationale: The printed equations admit an exact block-triangular reduction. In the four-dimensional model the added scalar contributes the exponent \(b<0\). In the five-dimensional model \(H=y+\phi\) is conserved, and coordinates \((x,y,z,h,u)\) expose diagonal cocycle blocks \(A_c(t)\), \(0\), and \(-b\). The three-dimensional base is autonomous with divergence \(-1\) and therefore has at most one positive exponent on non-equilibrium ergodic recurrent dynamics. At equilibria the base factor is \((\lambda+1)(\lambda^2+2c)\), so there is no positive real part. Exact-rational checks independently reproduce the first-integral cancellation, equilibrium residuals, polynomial factorizations, and divergence sums.

value.rationale: The finding corrects the central qualitative classification of both continuous-time systems in the source, rather than merely adjusting a number. The 5D model additionally has a global first integral that reduces the effective recurrent dynamics and makes the equilibrium spectrum independent of the memristor coordinate. These are structurally useful facts for bifurcation analysis, simulation validation, and any use of the models as hyperchaotic signal generators.
